resources.string: Returns home when HyperOS lands in the app drawer after a swipe-up gesture
Steps: 1. Enable the toggle. 2. Turn on “Home Fix” in accessibility settings. 3. Disable battery optimization so HyperOS does not kill the service.
Only auto-home if the drawer opens within this time after leaving an app. Lower = fewer false triggers.
Delay before auto-home fires. Lower = faster (drawer less visible), higher = smoother.
Gap between the 1st and 2nd home action (search case: search → drawer → home). Raise if the search case lands on the drawer.
No log yet. Reproduce the bug (open app from drawer search, then swipe up), then tap Refresh.
Automatically returns to the home screen when HyperOS lands in the app drawer or app-drawer search after a swipe-up-to-home gesture.
